Container.Name: Lineup
Container.Overview: Lineup provides a web dashboard for multi-tuner management and proxying, live TV streaming, scheduled guide collection, and guide output for media servers such as Jellyfin and Plex.[br][br]CPU-only operation is the default. For AMD or Intel hardware encoding, configure the host graphics driver and add [b]--device=/dev/dri[/b] to Extra Parameters in Advanced View. For least-privilege access, use only the selected render node, such as [b]--device=/dev/dri/renderD128[/b]. If needed, also add [b]--group-add=<gid>[/b] using the render node's numeric group. Select VA-API for AMD; Intel can use QSV or VA-API.[br][br]For NVIDIA NVENC, install the Unraid NVIDIA driver/runtime, add [b]--runtime=nvidia[/b] to Extra Parameters unless it is already the default runtime, and enter the GPU UUID or selected index in [b]NVIDIA Visible Devices[/b]. The Lineup image supplies the required NVIDIA driver capabilities.[br][br]Exposing a GPU does not force transcoding; Lineup uses hardware encoding only when the effective settings require video conversion. AMD AMF is supported only for native Windows, not this Linux container.[br][br][b]IMPORTANT FOR 3.0 UPGRADES:[/b] Lineup 3.0 intentionally does not migrate state from earlier releases. Back up existing data, then complete Lineup's required factory reset or select a clean Appdata host directory. Lineup 3.0 uses /guide for generated guide outputs and TCP ports 8600-8615 for optional dedicated virtual-output listeners.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-11-15 - Added Intel/AMD and NVIDIA hardware-transcoding setup guidance and optional NVIDIA GPU selection. - CPU-only deployments remain unchanged and require no GPU configuration. - Changed the restart policy to unless-stopped so a manual stop persists across Unraid or Docker restarts.
### 2026-11-13 - Updated the template for Lineup 3.0.0. - BREAKING: Lineup 3.0 is an intentional configuration and storage reset. Back up existing data, then complete the required factory reset or use a clean Appdata host directory; persisted state from earlier releases is not migrated. - Replaced the /xmltv mapping with /guide for generated guide outputs. - Added the optional TCP 8600-8615 dedicated virtual-output listener range. - Removed unsupported PUID, PGID, and UMASK environment fields.
### 2026-10-04 - Updated the template for Lineup 2.2.0. - Added the transient stream data mapping used for CMAF fragments and subtitle sidecars.
### 2026-09-17 - Updated the template for Lineup 2.0.0. - BREAKING HOST LAYOUT: Appdata now defaults to /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data on the host and maps to /appdata in the container. - BEFORE STARTING 2.0: existing users must move or copy their prior Lineup appdata contents (whether previously mapped to /config or /appdata) into /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data, or explicitly retain their existing Appdata host-path mapping. Otherwise, Lineup starts as a new installation. - HTTPS certificates remain in the separate /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/certs directory and must not be moved into the data directory. - Added the HDHomeRun discovery/proxy and SSDP UDP port mappings. - Added read-only HTTPS certificate directory, optional certificate password, and optional OpenTelemetry settings.
### 2026-02-25 - Initial release

Config.Name: Web Interface (HTTP)
Config.Description: Host port mapped to Lineup's HTTP listener on TCP port 8080.

Config.Name: Web Interface (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Optional host port mapped to Lineup's HTTPS listener on TCP port 8443. HTTPS must be configured in Lineup.

Config.Name: Virtual Output Listeners
Config.Description: Optional dedicated virtual-output listener range. The host range must contain the same number of ports as the fixed container range. Leave at 8600-8615 unless those host ports conflict.

Config.Name: HDHomeRun Discovery / Proxy
Config.Description: Optional UDP port used for HDHomeRun discovery and proxy traffic.

Config.Name: SSDP Discovery
Config.Description: Optional UDP port used for SSDP discovery traffic.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Lineup settings, database, and other application-owned state. Lineup 3.0 does not migrate state from earlier releases; back up existing data, then complete the required factory reset or select a clean host directory.

Config.Name: Guide Output
Config.Description: Host path where Lineup stores generated guide outputs, including XMLTV and JSON files.

Config.Name: Transient Stream Data
Config.Description: RAM-backed host path for temporary CMAF fragments and subtitle sidecars. Contents are cleared when Unraid reboots. Active streams consume system memory; use a disk-backed host path instead if memory is limited or many concurrent streams are expected.

Config.Name: HTTPS Certificate Directory
Config.Description: Host directory containing the HTTPS certificate named lineup.pfx. The certificate is available in the container at /app/certs/lineup.pfx.

Config.Name: HTTPS Certificate Password
Config.Description: Optional password for lineup.pfx. Leave blank when using a passwordless PFX certificate.

Config.Name: OpenTelemetry Endpoint
Config.Description: Optional OTLP endpoint. Leave blank to disable OpenTelemetry export.

Config.Name: OpenTelemetry Protocol
Config.Description: OTLP transport protocol. Supported values are httpProtobuf and grpc.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices
Config.Description: Optional NVIDIA GPU UUID or selected host index. Requires the Unraid NVIDIA driver/container runtime and --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters unless NVIDIA is already the default runtime. Leave blank for CPU-only, Intel, or AMD deployments.
